(0:50)Roman Reigns defeats an exhausted CM Punk at WrestleMania 42 to become the new World Heavyweight Champion. (0:50)ESPN staffApr 19, 2026, 09:35 PM ETMultiple AuthorsShareCopy LinkEmailPrint LikeOpen Extended Reactions3.5KReactions Like3.4K Fire11 Wow9 Laugh6 Celebrate3 Interesting2Roman Reigns is a champion once again, beating CM Punk in the WrestleMania Night 2 main event Sunday at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas. Reigns and Punk fought valiantly. Punk used every move in his arsenal to fend off the OTC, but it wasn't enough. With the win, Reigns now holds the WWE World Heavyweight Championship.Night 2 opened with rising fan favorite Oba Femi beating Brock Lesnar to the point of Lesnar leaving his gloves and shoes in the middle of the ring after the match. Will we see him compete in WWE again?Also on the card, Rhea Ripley beat Jade Cargill in a match for the Women's World Championship, Trick Williams lemon pepper stepped his way to a Men's United States Championship win, and Penta retained his Men's Intercontinental Championship by winning a six-man ladder match.Here are the highlights from WrestleMania 42 Night 2.
